result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), Article 3, Division 2, covering water well definitions, construction standards, permits, nuisance abatement and inspections.
result.notes: This part of the document is about well construction and permitting, which is outside the six rental-housing categories. Although the page URL refers to a San Diego division on prohibiting algorithmic rent price-fixing (Zoning Division 11, \u00a798.1103), the retrieved text does not contain that section or any rent-setting provision, so no rules are extracted. The text of the algorithmic-device prohibition may appear in another part of the document.
